evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced specialty: 3. The existing unordered-specialty rule applies when at least one reviewer identifies a specialty track. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Practical Android and iOS testing constitutes a focused mobile-application specialization; recorded peer recognition supports its usefulness, while auto-grading and limited independent recognition constrain broader seniority claims.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Practical Android and iOS testing forms a focused mobile-application specialization. The two-year profile and real targets are useful, while auto-grading and provider-focused training limit evidence of broader pentest seniority.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded Android and iOS practical extends a prior offensive track into mobile application testing. That distinct attack surface and community reputation support specialty placement despite limited independent recognition.
